tools.name: godot_editor_status
tools.description: Read editor identity, session, play and import status.

tools.name: godot_editor_capabilities
tools.description: Read supported bridge commands and language availability.

tools.name: godot_editor_tree
tools.description: Read the bounded currently edited scene using root-relative paths.

tools.name: godot_editor_get_node
tools.description: Read a node and bounded stored properties, including script exports.

tools.name: godot_editor_set_node_property
tools.description: Opt-in typed edit with editor Undo/Redo and readback. Requires addon permission and server trust; does not save.

tools.name: godot_editor_output
tools.description: Query live editor logs. Returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED on the compatibility baseline.

tools.name: godot_editor_save_all
tools.description: Explicitly request saving open scenes.

tools.name: godot_editor_open_scene
tools.description: Request opening a project-local res:// .tscn scene.

tools.name: godot_editor_filesystem_scan
tools.description: Request a filesystem/import scan. Imports can execute project code; requires trust.

tools.name: godot_editor_run_project
tools.description: Request play once, then normally wait for a ready runtime with matching project identity and a fresh session.

tools.name: godot_editor_stop_project
tools.description: Request stop once and wait for play mode and the observed runtime session to end.

tools.name: godot_runtime_status
tools.description: Read project/session identity, scene readiness, frames and pause state.

tools.name: godot_runtime_capabilities
tools.description: Read runtime commands, language support and feature gates.

tools.name: godot_runtime_tree
tools.description: Read a bounded runtime subtree with paths relative to /root.

tools.name: godot_runtime_get_node
tools.description: Read a runtime node and stored properties.

tools.name: godot_runtime_get_property
tools.description: Read a typed runtime property.

tools.name: godot_runtime_set_property
tools.description: Opt-in typed debug write with readback. Requires addon permission and server trust; no runtime Undo guarantee.

tools.name: godot_runtime_bridge_logs
tools.description: Query bridge logs. Unsupported capture is reported as an error, not an empty success.

tools.name: godot_runtime_perf
tools.description: Read native performance counters.

tools.name: godot_runtime_pause
tools.description: Pause gameplay without pausing the development bridge.

tools.name: godot_runtime_resume
tools.description: Resume gameplay.

tools.name: godot_runtime_screenshot
tools.description: Read a main-viewport PNG with render-time metadata, normally as an MCP image block.

tools.name: godot_runtime_snapshot
tools.description: Read engine state and opt-in project snapshot providers without assuming gameplay services.

tools.name: godot_runtime_input_actions
tools.description: List InputMap actions and the explicit automation allowlist.

tools.name: godot_runtime_send_action
tools.description: Send an allowlisted Godot InputEventAction. Presses automatically expire within one second.

tools.name: godot_runtime_wait_ready
tools.description: Wait for this project's ready runtime; optionally assert session, scene and node.

tools.name: godot_runtime_capture_frame
tools.description: Wait for actual rendered frames, verify scene/session, and return PNG provenance without changing the camera.
